name: Sailthru
description: Marigold Engage by Sailthru provides audience profiles, lists, content, campaigns, triggered messaging, recommendations, and commerce events.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned API key/secret and non-sensitive staging health list. Relay pins five signed operations: one exact list read runs directly, two exact user/template reads and two preference writes require approval, writes require contact authorization, and subscription or opt-out removal additionally requires double-opt-in evidence.

credentialRequirements.name: SAILTHRU_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Sailthru API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned API key, preferably restricted to Railway staging egress IPs.

credentialRequirements.name: SAILTHRU_API_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Sailthru API secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay uses this only to calculate the provider-required per-request signature.

credentialRequirements.name: SAILTHRU_HEALTH_LIST
credentialRequirements.label: Sailthru health-check list
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use one non-sensitive staging list name for exact read-only health checks.

capabilities.label: Read one list
capabilities.description: Use one exact aggregate list read.

capabilities.label: Read user or template
capabilities.description: Use exact user/template reads with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage user preferences
capabilities.description: Use exact list/opt-out writes with approval and authorization attestations.

allowed.label: Read Sailthru list
allowed.description: Read aggregate metadata for one exact natural list.

approvalRequired.label: Read Sailthru user or template
approvalRequired.description: Read one email user profile or one named messaging template.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Sailthru preferences
approvalRequired.description: Change one authorized user's exact list membership or email opt-out status.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: API keys, secrets, request signatures, and credential-bearing response fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk or job APIs
blocked.description: Jobs, imports, exports, multi-send, files, purchase/event streams, recommendations, and unbounded reads are excluded.

blocked.label: Send or administer messaging
blocked.description: Send/blast launch, content/template/list mutation, user deletion, webhooks, settings, and account administration remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only five pinned operations run on three fixed endpoints; arbitrary endpoints, methods, fields, URLs, headers, and oversized data are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One exact list read runs directly; exact user/template reads and preference writes require approval, writes require contact authorization, and subscribing or removing opt-out additionally requires double-opt-in evidence.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All five selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; authorization/double-opt-in attestations, fixed routing, signing, bounds, audits, and bulk/send/admin blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts five pinned Sailthru operations and calculates the provider-required signature without exposing the API secret or signature to agents.

providerSetup.blocker: Sailthru requires a customer-owned API key/secret, optional IP restrictions, non-sensitive staging health list, and permission-based subscription process. No console, account, key/secret, list, user, consent, template, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure dedicated staging credentials and health list in Railway staging, restrict source IPs where practical, and verify signing, list/user/template reads, approval and contact/double-opt-in denial/allow, subscribe/unsubscribe and opt-out behavior, response/rate bounds, credential rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Sailthru documents the fixed HTTPS API origin, GET/POST behavior, form-encoded JSON requests, API key/secret signature algorithm, JSON responses, optional IP restrictions, and endpoint/method rate headers.
The official Java client guide documents exact user GET/POST and template GET semantics, email-key lookup, list membership maps, and profile fields.
Sailthru documents user variables, profile sensitivity, list and API update paths, value limits, and bulk alternatives excluded by Relay.
Marigold documents permission, privacy, and restricted sensitive-data obligations applicable to messaging services.
